description: CL:0000939 (CD16-positive, CD56-dim NK cell, human) does not distinguish CD57-negative (NK1) from CD57-positive (NK3) substates; both SOULCAP rows currently map to the same CL term at Broad match type.

No human-specific "group 1 innate lymphoid cell" CL term exists, unlike group 2 (CL:0001081) and group 3 (CL:0001078); confirmed by direct OLS4 search returning zero hits for the human-qualified query.

SOULCAP row has all four marker columns (Required/Ideal exclusion, Required/Ideal phenotypic markers) completely empty in the master sheet — there is no marker definition to match against at all, so no CL candidate can be derived from markers. Distinct from the more specific "T3" (Transitional B cell 3) row, which does have marker data.

Sheet's Full Name reads "Cytotoxice Natural Killer Cell" (typo, extra trailing "e"); this broke batch lexical search entirely for the row (zero OLS4 hits). Marker-based match was unaffected. Cannot be fixed in this repo — requires a correction in the Google Sheet master.

Sheet's Full Name reads "Peripheral Dendritic Cell," but the row's markers (CD123hi, CD303+, low CD33) are the textbook definition of plasmacytoid dendritic cells — likely a wrong word, should probably read "Plasmacytoid." This broke batch lexical search (returned an unrelated "migratory dendritic cell" hit). Cannot be fixed in this repo — requires a correction in the Google Sheet master.

CL:0000576 (plain "monocyte") has zero marker axiom rows in cl_pro_relationships.tsv — same parent-class axiom-gap pattern as NK/ILC/cDC/B cell. Match is lexical-only (OAK-verified), not marker-confirmed.

CL:0000860/CL:0000875/CL:0002393 assert only CCR2 (CD192) and CX3CR1 status plus lineage negatives — none assert the CD14/CD16 axioms that actually define these three subsets per Ziegler-Heitbrock et al. 2010 (PMID:20628149). Already covered by repo issue #12 (filed upstream as CL#3665) — not a new gap, cited here for context on why these rows can only be matched lexically.

Required exclusion column reads "CD56- CD19- ([CD123hi]- CD303-) ([CD123hi|CD193-)" for all four rows — the second group is missing a "]" after CD123hi (likely should read "([CD123hi]-|CD193-)", matching the cDC/pDC pattern). Cannot be fixed in this repo — requires a correction in the Google Sheet master.

CL:0000236 (plain "B cell") has zero marker axiom rows in cl_pro_relationships.tsv — same parent-class axiom-gap pattern as NK/ILC/cDC/monocyte. Match is lexical-only (OAK-verified after OLS4 REST search returned zero hits for this exact query), not marker-confirmed.

SOULCAP defines four "double negative" B cell subsets (DN1-4, the atypical/age-associated B cell scheme from the autoimmunity/aging literature) via CD21/CD11c/CD185/IgE combinations. CL has only the general parent CL:0000981 "double negative memory B cell" with no DN1-4 subtyping; direct searches for "DN1 B cell" through "DN4 B cell" and "atypical memory B cell" returned zero CL hits. All four SOULCAP rows currently collapse to the same Broad match.

SOULCAP distinguishes IgD+IgM- ("IgD only") from IgD+IgM+ ("Unswitched") memory B cells as two separate populations. No CL term exists for the IgD+IgM- subset — direct searches for "IgD-positive memory B cell" and "IgD only memory B cell" returned zero hits; the only IgD-related term found, CL:0001053 "IgD-negative memory B cell," is the opposite polarity. Left unmapped rather than forced onto a wrong-polarity term.

Refinement (2026-09-25): SOULCAP's bare "CD8" marker (mapped to the CD8 alpha chain, PR:000001084) can't distinguish the conventional CD8-alpha-beta heterodimer (typical of alpha-beta T cells) from the CD8-alpha-alpha homodimer (typical of gamma-delta T cells, some intraepithelial/innate-like T cells, and NK cells) — but this doesn't affect the CD8+ alpha-beta exactMatches, since CL:0000625 and its subtypes only assert the alpha chain and never require the beta chain. It does sharpen the CD8+ TCRgd gap though: CL does model CD8-alpha-alpha-positive gamma-delta T cells, just only in the intraepithelial-restricted branch (CL:0000802, CL:0002513, CL:0002514) — there is no generic, tissue-unrestricted CD8-positive gamma-delta T cell term for a blood/PBMC panel like SOULCAP's to map to.

SOULCAP crosses CD56 positivity with CD4/CD8/DP/DN status and TCRab/TCRgd lineage (13 variants); CL has only one term at this level (CL:4052055, pending rename to "CD56-positive T cell, human" per issue #13) with no further subdivision. All 13 rows Broad-match to CL:4052055.

description: [Draft B1] One issue for both terms: remove or disable 'lacks_plasma_membrane_part HLA-DRA' (PR:000002015) on CL:0000938 (CD16-negative, CD56-bright NK, human) and CL:0000939 (CD16-positive, CD56-dim NK, human) until a source is found (Dr. Diehl, 2026-10-05). One issue because both share the same axiom, the same two definition sources and the same evidence. Neither source supports it: PMID:19796267 never mentions HLA-DR; PMID:22343568 mentions HLA-DR on NK cells only as an activation marker. Human evidence: most resting NK cells are HLA-DR− (Evans 2011, PMID:21491418), but an HLA-DR+ subset exists ex vivo, mostly CD56bright and in some individuals CD56dim (Erokhina 2018, PMID:29363179). HLA-DRA is human-only (PRO: mouse ortholog H2-Ea). Proposed labels: gap. [14 Oct 2026: approved by Dr. Diehl, "safe to remove it for now"; file after Alex's OK.]
